meta.name: Scanner research + strategy memory bootstrap
meta.status: working research memory, not established physics

nodes.label: Self-reflexive operator
nodes.summary: Minimal local recursive operator; field/state is memory; no extra stabilizing rules.

nodes.label: No-extra-rules directive
nodes.summary: Implement only explicitly defined operator/experiment; deviations must be separated and agreed.

nodes.label: Recursive scanner pipeline
nodes.summary: scan → blind test → complement → internal graph → phenomenology → prediction → falsification → residual → recurse

nodes.label: Graph-pattern analogy
nodes.summary: Structural analogy narrows hypothesis space but is not evidence of causal identity.

nodes.label: Model-world structural distance
nodes.summary: Model fit should be treated as measurable structural correspondence, not ontological identity.

nodes.label: Emergent time completeness ladder
nodes.summary: L1/L2/L3 clocks showed strong representation dependence; L3 dynamic state restored clock quality.

nodes.label: Multi-clock uncertainty null
nodes.summary: No Heisenberg-like reciprocal law emerged; effective law changed strongly with clock representation.

nodes.label: Eotvos analogue
nodes.summary: Heterogeneous object family did not show universal free-fall-like invariance; representation/common clock underresolved.

nodes.label: Electron recursive scan
nodes.summary: Dynamic/history graph improved odd field-response closure; curvature/inertia-like channel remained unresolved.

nodes.label: Simple complement is not charge complement
nodes.summary: Amplitude/orientation complement did not reverse charge-like odd response; dipole complement mainly affected even/polarization channel.

nodes.label: Negative results are memory
nodes.summary: Failures, nulls and representation breakdowns are first-class strategic information.

nodes.label: Cross-law meta-graph
nodes.summary: Intersect independently reconstructed law-graphs to search for deeper common latent structure.
